name_en: Beijing Offroad (北京越野, BAIC brand)
name_zh: 北京越野（北汽集团旗下品牌）

key_facts.value_en: 1966 (the Beijing BJ212 light off-road vehicle was approved for series production in May 1966; development began in 1960)
key_facts.value_zh: 1966 年（北京牌 BJ212 轻型越野车于 1966 年 5 月定型投产；研发始于 1960 年）

key_facts.value_en: BAIC Group (北京汽车集团有限公司). Beijing Offroad is part of the Beijing brand under listed BAIC Motor (01958.HK). Public filings do not show Beijing Automotive Group Off-road Vehicle Co., Ltd. as a subsidiary of 01958.HK.
key_facts.value_zh: 北汽集团（北京汽车集团有限公司）。北京越野属于上市公司北京汽车股份有限公司（01958.HK）整车板块中的北京品牌。公开文件未列示「北京汽车集团越野车有限公司」为 01958.HK 的子公司。

key_facts.value_en: China's self-styled 'off-road family' (越野世家) and 'inventor of the Chinese off-road vehicle', spanning hardcore off-road (BJ40/BJ60/BJ80), light off-road (BJ30) and, since 2026, the luxury Taitan and mainstream Xingtan sub-brands
key_facts.value_zh: 自居「越野世家」「中国越野车发明者」，覆盖硬派越野（BJ40/BJ60/BJ80）、轻越野（BJ30），并自 2026 年起推出豪华越野子品牌泰钽与主流新能源子品牌星钽

key_facts.value_en: Three families: the BJ series (BJ30/BJ40/BJ60/BJ80), the Taitan luxury off-road sub-brand (Taitan 700) and the Xingtan mainstream NEV sub-brand (Xingtan 5X)
key_facts.value_zh: 三条产品线：BJ 系列（BJ30/BJ40/BJ60/BJ80）、泰钽豪华越野子品牌（泰钽 700）与星钽主流新能源子品牌（星钽 5X）

key_facts.value_en: State-owned (brand of the state-owned BAIC Group, operated by listed BAIC Motor)
key_facts.value_zh: 国有（北汽集团旗下品牌，由上市公司北京汽车运营）

key_facts.value_en: Not separately listed; parent BAIC Motor is listed in Hong Kong (01958.HK)
key_facts.value_zh: 未单独上市；母公司北京汽车股份有限公司在港交所上市（01958.HK）

key_facts.value_en: Over 200,000 units (+38% YoY, BAIC Group basis); boxy 'box' models delivered 147,499 (+72%)
key_facts.value_zh: 超 20 万辆（同比 +38%，北汽集团口径）；方盒子车型交付 147,499 辆（同比 +72%）
8.46 万辆；方盒子车型交付 6.67 万辆（同比 +33.9%）

key_facts.value_en: Beijing Offroad Smart Factory, Zhaoquanying, Shunyi District, Beijing (about 540,000 sq m; media-reported capacity of roughly 100,000 vehicles/year)
key_facts.value_zh: 北京越野智能工厂（北京顺义区赵全营镇，占地约 54 万平方米，媒体披露年产能力约 10 万辆）

history.event_en: Beijing Automobile Works formally starts developing a light off-road vehicle, building on the earlier Jinggangshan and Dongfanghong sedan programmes.
history.event_zh: 北京汽车制造厂在「井冈山」「东方红」轿车试制基础上，正式启动轻型越野车开发。

history.event_en: The BJ210 light off-road vehicle developed by BAW is formally named the 'Beijing' (北京) brand.
history.event_zh: 北汽研制的 BJ210 轻型越野车被正式定名为「北京」牌。

history.event_en: The Beijing BJ212 light off-road vehicle is approved for series production in May 1966. The BJ212 and its derivatives go on to sell over 1.2 million units over more than 50 years, taking over 80% of China's light off-road market at its peak.
history.event_zh: 1966 年 5 月，北京牌 BJ212 轻型越野车定型并安排生产；此后 BJ212 及衍生车型畅销 50 多年、累计超 120 万辆，鼎盛时占全国轻型越野车市场份额 80% 以上。

history.event_en: Beijing Jeep Corporation is established with American Motors (AMC) as China's first Sino-foreign whole-vehicle joint venture (formally opening in January 1984), a partnership through which the BJ212 line was upgraded.
history.event_zh: 与美国汽车公司（AMC）合资成立北京吉普汽车有限公司，为中国第一家整车制造合资企业（1984 年 1 月正式开业），BJ212 由此得以改进升级。

history.event_en: The Beijing 40 (BJ40), BAIC's first modern hardcore off-road vehicle and a tribute to the BJ212, is launched at the Water Cube, priced RMB146,800-186,800; BAIC chairman Xu Heyi says it reopens the 'off-road family' (越野世家).
history.event_zh: 北京 40（BJ40）在北京水立方上市，售价 14.68 万—18.68 万元，是北京汽车首款现代硬派越野车、向 BJ212 致敬之作；北汽董事长徐和谊称其拉开重振「越野世家」大幕。

history.event_en: The BJ80, a full-size hardcore off-roader with a Mercedes-Benz G-Class-like silhouette, is launched from RMB298,000; in 2025 it served as a parade gun-salute-towing and press-support vehicle at the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the end of the War of Resistance.
history.event_zh: 北京 BJ80 上市，起售价 29.8 万元，外观与奔驰 G 级相似；2025 年抗战胜利 80 周年大会上担任阅兵礼炮牵引车与新闻保障车。

history.event_en: BAIC Group relaunches the 'BEIJING' brand, folding the Senova nameplate into it; the off-road line continues under the Beijing brand as the '越野世家' core.
history.event_zh: 北汽集团发布全新 BEIJING 品牌，绅宝并入其中；越野车系作为「越野世家」核心继续归于北京品牌之下。

history.event_en: A fully redesigned BJ40 is unveiled at the Guangzhou auto show, ten years after the original; in 2023 the four main models (BJ40/BJ60/BJ80/BJ90) sold about 34,000 units.
history.event_zh: 全新换代 BJ40 在广州车展亮相（距首代上市十年）；2023 年 BJ40、BJ60、BJ80、BJ90 四款主力车型合计销量约 3.4 万辆。

history.event_en: The BJ30 light off-road SUV is launched in May as a deep-hybrid light off-road four-wheel-drive model, the first application of the 'Magic Core Electric Drive' (魔核电驱) off-road electrification solution that BAIC released that year.
history.event_zh: BJ30「深混轻野电四驱 SUV」于 5 月上市，为北汽当年发布的「魔核电驱超级驱动方案」首个落地车型。

history.event_en: The BJ40 EREV (range-extended) goes on sale on 23 April at the Shanghai auto show with an official guide price of RMB179,800-199,800 (from RMB154,800 after national and trade-in subsidies); the BJ40 petrol facelift follows in July.
history.event_zh: BJ40 增程于 4 月 23 日上海车展上市，官方指导价 17.98 万—19.98 万元（叠加国补及置换补贴后焕新价最低 15.48 万元起）；7 月 BJ40 燃油新款上市。

history.event_en: Beijing Offroad sells over 200,000 units (+38%); NEV share nears 40%. BAIC Group's scorecard says the BJ40 led hardcore off-road sales for 11 straight months and the BJ40 EREV led the EREV box segment for 9 months. BAIC Motor's site, reprinting China Securities Journal (published 23 January 2026), says the BJ40 series has ranked first in hardcore off-road sales since July 2025. July to December is six months, so the two accounts conflict and both are kept. Boxy models delivered 147,499 units (+72%).
history.event_zh: 北京越野全年销量超 20 万辆（同比 +38%），新能源占比接近 40%，方盒子车型交付 147,499 辆（同比 +72%）。北汽集团成绩单称 BJ40 连续 11 个月居硬派越野销量冠军、BJ40 增程连续 9 个月居增程式方盒子销量冠军；北京汽车官网转载的《中国证券报》（页面发布时间 2026-01-23）写 BJ40 系列自 2025 年 7 月起稳居硬派越野市场销量榜首。7 月至 12 月只有 6 个月，两说冲突，此处并列保留。

history.event_en: The Beijing Offroad Smart Factory's monthly output passes 10,000 units for the first time in September. The same ceremony's report that cumulative production passed 3.2 million vehicles refers to four bases together — the Shunyi smart factory plus BAIC Zhuzhou, Guangzhou and Kunming — not Beijing Offroad off-road vehicles alone.
history.event_zh: 北京越野智能工厂 9 月单月产量首次突破 1 万辆。同一仪式报道中的「累计生产突破 320 万辆」，是以顺义智能工厂为核心，加上北汽株洲、广州、昆明基地的四大基地合计产量，不是北京越野越野车的单一产量。

history.event_en: Zhang Guofu's resignation as BAIC Bluepark chairman takes effect on 19 March 2026, and the company announces it on 20 March. The same day the BAIC Motor board only proposes appointing him as a non-executive director and, if shareholders approve, nominating him as chairman. Wang Hao's resignation takes effect when that appointment is approved. The EGM is set for 14 April 2026. He is not yet chairman of BAIC Motor.
history.event_zh: 张国富卸任北汽蓝谷董事长，离任于 2026 年 3 月 19 日生效，公司于 2026 年 3 月 20 日公告。同日北京汽车董事会只是建议委任他为非执行董事，待股东批准后再提名董事长；王昊卸任自新董事委任获股东批准之日起生效。临时股东会订于 2026 年 4 月 14 日。此时他尚未出任北京汽车董事长。

history.event_en: BAIC Motor's EGM approves Zhang Guofu's appointment as a non-executive director. The board the same day appoints him chairman, effective 14 April 2026, succeeding Wang Hao.
history.event_zh: 北京汽车临时股东会通过张国富出任非执行董事。董事会同日委任他为董事长，任期自 2026 年 4 月 14 日起，接替王昊。

history.event_en: Beijing Offroad holds its first 'off-road Naadam and user ecosystem conference' and releases the 'Yueye 5+' user system spanning bases, clubs, events, service and modification.
history.event_zh: 北京越野举办首届「越野那达慕暨用户生态大会」，发布「悦野五+」用户体系，覆盖基地、俱乐部、活动、服务、改装五大板块。

history.event_en: Beijing Offroad unveils the luxury off-road sub-brand Taitan (泰钽) and starts pre-sales of its first model, the Taitan 700, at RMB299,800-389,800; the 'Beijing Offroad x Huawei Yinwang joint off-road centre' is formally inaugurated at the same event.
history.event_zh: 北京越野发布豪华越野子品牌「泰钽」，首款车型泰钽 700 同步开启预售，预售价 29.98 万—38.98 万元；发布会现场「北京越野×华为引望联合越野中心」正式成立并挂牌。

history.event_en: The Taitan 700 is officially launched with three versions at a launch ('huaxin') price of RMB249,800-349,800 (guide prices RMB279,800-379,800); BAIC said cumulative pre-sale orders exceeded 10,000.
history.event_zh: 泰钽 700 正式上市，3 个版型焕新价 24.98 万—34.98 万元（官方指导价 27.98 万—37.98 万元）；北京越野称预售以来累计订单超 1 万辆。

history.event_en: Beijing Offroad officially launches the Xingtan (星钽) brand and starts pre-sales of its first model, the Xingtan 5X, from RMB139,900.
history.event_zh: 北京越野正式发布「星钽」品牌，首款车型星钽 5X 同步开启预售、13.99 万元起。

brands.name_zh: 悦野性能系列（BJ40 / BJ60 / BJ80）
brands.role_en: The core hardcore off-road line, spanning compact (BJ40), mid-to-large (BJ60) and full-size/military-grade (BJ80) off-roaders in petrol and EREV forms.
brands.role_zh: 核心硬派越野产品线，覆盖紧凑型 BJ40、中大型 BJ60 与全尺寸/军规 BJ80，提供燃油与增程两种动力。
brands.price_band: About RMB 140,000-300,000 (BJ40 EREV from RMB179,800; BJ80 from RMB298,000)
brands.owner_note_en: BJ40 is the volume anchor. For 2025, BAIC Group says the BJ40 led hardcore off-road sales for 11 straight months and the BJ40 EREV led the EREV box segment for 9 months; BAIC Motor's reprint of China Securities Journal (published 23 January 2026) says the BJ40 series has ranked first since July 2025. The two accounts conflict and both are kept. The BJ40 EREV launched on 23 April 2025 from RMB179,800 (guide price RMB179,800-199,800). The BJ80 launched in April 2016 from RMB298,000. A new BJ60 with Huawei assisted driving was planned for Q2 2026.
brands.owner_note_zh: BJ40 为销量基盘。2025 年，北汽集团称 BJ40 连续 11 个月居硬派越野销量冠军、BJ40 增程连续 9 个月居增程式方盒子销量冠军；北京汽车官网转载的《中国证券报》（页面发布时间 2026-01-23）写 BJ40 系列自 2025 年 7 月起稳居硬派越野销量榜首。两说冲突，并列保留。BJ40 增程 2025 年 4 月 23 日上市、官方指导价 17.98 万—19.98 万元。BJ80 于 2016 年 4 月上市、29.8 万元起；搭载华为智驾的全新 BJ60 计划 2026 年二季度发布。

brands.role_en: The light off-road line, an urban/family-oriented 'soft-roader' positioned around the RMB100,000 class to open up the mass market.
brands.role_zh: 轻越野产品线，面向城市与家庭使用的「轻野」SUV，主打 10 万元级，承担大众市场破圈任务。
brands.owner_note_en: The BJ30 launched in May 2024 as a deep-hybrid light off-road four-wheel-drive SUV. In 2024 it was the brand's top seller at 41,400 units. The BJ30 Traveller High-light edition was among the new models added in H1 2026.
brands.owner_note_zh: BJ30 于 2024 年 5 月作为「深混轻野电四驱 SUV」上市，2024 年销量 4.14 万辆、为品牌销量主力；2026 上半年又推出 BJ30 旅行家高光版等新品。

brands.role_en: A luxury intelligent off-road sub-brand launched in July 2026, combining an EREV powertrain with Huawei Qiankun ADS assisted driving to move Beijing Offroad above RMB300,000.
brands.role_zh: 2026 年 7 月推出的豪华智能越野子品牌，以增程动力叠加华为乾崑智驾，推动北京越野向 30 万元级以上市场升级。
brands.owner_note_en: The first model, the Taitan 700, is a full-size hardcore off-road SUV with a 1.5T range extender, CATL Xiaoyao off-road battery and Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 MAX assisted driving. Pre-sales began on 21 July 2026 at RMB299,800-389,800; it launched on 25 August 2026 at a launch ('huaxin') price of RMB249,800-349,800 (guide prices RMB279,800-379,800), and BAIC said cumulative pre-sale orders passed 10,000.
brands.owner_note_zh: 首款车型泰钽 700 为全尺寸硬派越野 SUV，搭载 1.5T 增程器、宁德时代骁遥电池越野专研版与华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 MAX。2026 年 7 月 21 日开启预售、预售价 29.98 万—38.98 万元；8 月 25 日正式上市、焕新价 24.98 万—34.98 万元（官方指导价 27.98 万—37.98 万元），北京越野称预售以来累计订单超 1 万辆。

brands.name_zh: 星钽（主流新能源子品牌）
brands.role_en: A mainstream family-oriented 'large-space smart SUV' sub-brand launched in October 2026, tasked with widening Beijing Offroad's reach from niche off-road circles into the mass family NEV market.
brands.role_zh: 2026 年 10 月推出的主流家庭「大空间智慧 SUV」子品牌，承担把北京越野从小众越野圈层带入主流家用新能源大众市场的「向宽」走量任务。
brands.owner_note_en: The first model, the Xingtan 5X, was launched together with the Xingtan brand on 21 October 2026 from RMB139,900, with 7 versions (3 battery-electric, 4 plug-in hybrid). The BEV has CLTC range of 625 km on an 800V platform, and higher trims carry Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 Pro assisted driving.
brands.owner_note_zh: 首款车型星钽 5X 于 2026 年 10 月 21 日随品牌发布开启预售、13.99 万元起，共 7 款车型（纯电 3 款、插混 4 款）。纯电版 CLTC 续航 625 公里、基于 800V 平台，中高配搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 Pro。

financials.standard: Not disclosed at brand level; parent BAIC Motor (01958.HK) FY2025 annual results prepared under IFRS
financials.note_en: Beijing Offroad (北京越野) is the own-brand off-road vehicle business of BAIC Motor Corporation Limited (01958.HK), a subsidiary of the wholly state-owned BAIC Group, and publishes no separate brand-level financial statements. No brand-level revenue, gross margin, net profit, R&D or cash-flow figures are therefore shown, and none are estimated. For reference, parent BAIC Motor reported consolidated revenue of RMB164,047.0 million and net profit attributable to equity holders of the parent of RMB122.7 million for FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025, prepared under IFRS and disclosed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange), down 14.8% and 87.2% year on year respectively, according to the BAIC Motor 2025 annual report. For H1 2026 (six months ended 30 June 2026, unaudited, prepared under IAS 34 and disclosed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange), parent BAIC Motor reported revenue of RMB57,726 million (down 29.9% year on year) and a net loss attributable to equity holders of the company of RMB1,594 million, swinging from a RMB360 million profit a year earlier, per its 2026 interim results announcement. This page does not constitute any trading recommendation.
financials.note_zh: 北京越野（北京越野）是国有独资北汽集团旗下上市公司北京汽车股份有限公司（01958.HK）的自主越野车业务板块，未单独披露品牌层面的财务报表，故本表不列营收、毛利率、净利润、研发投入、现金流等品牌级财务数字，也不做估算。作为参照，其母公司北京汽车 2025 财年（截至 2025-12-31，按国际财务报告准则（IFRS）编制、港交所披露）实现合并营业收入 1640.47 亿元、归属于母公司股东（本公司权益持有人）净利润 1.23 亿元，同比分别下降 14.8% 与 87.2%（见北京汽车 2025 年年报）。2026 年中期（截至 2026-06-30，未经审计，按《国际会计准则》第 34 号编制、港交所披露），母公司北京汽车营业收入 577.26 亿元、同比下降 29.9%，本公司权益持有人应占净亏损 15.94 亿元，由上年同期盈利 3.60 亿元转为亏损（见北京汽车 2026 年中期业绩公告）。本页不构成任何交易推荐。

overview.en:
Beijing Offroad (北京越野) is the off-road vehicle brand of Beijing Automotive Group Co., Ltd. (BAIC Group), and part of the Beijing brand under Hong Kong-listed BAIC Motor Corporation Limited (01958.HK). Public filings do not show Beijing Automotive Group Off-road Vehicle Co., Ltd. as a subsidiary of 01958.HK or as the brand's operating company [s3][s37]. It presents itself as China's 'off-road family' (越野世家) and the originator of the country's off-road vehicle, tracing its lineage to the Beijing BJ212 light off-road vehicle approved for production in May 1966 [s1]. Its business is passenger off-road vehicles: hardcore off-roaders (BJ40, BJ60, BJ80), a light off-road SUV (BJ30), and, since 2026, the luxury Taitan sub-brand (Taitan 700) and the mainstream NEV sub-brand Xingtan (Xingtan 5X), with petrol, range-extended (EREV), plug-in hybrid and battery-electric powertrains and, increasingly, Huawei Qiankun assisted driving [s24][s31][s33].

After several quiet years, sales rebounded strongly: full-year 2025 sales exceeded 200,000 units, up 38% year on year on BAIC Group's basis, with 147,499 boxy 'box' models delivered (+72%), BAIC Group saying the BJ40 led hardcore off-road sales for 11 consecutive months and the BJ40 EREV led the EREV box segment for nine months, while BAIC Motor's reprint of China Securities Journal says the BJ40 series has ranked first since July 2025. The two accounts conflict and both are kept [s2][s3]. In the first half of 2026 the brand sold 84,600 vehicles, with 66,700 box models delivered (+33.9% year on year) [s15].

As a brand it is not separately listed and discloses no standalone financials; its results are consolidated in BAIC Motor. The Beijing brand, Beijing Benz, Beijing Hyundai and Fujian Benz are the four vehicle businesses under that listed company, not peers sitting beside it. Consolidated revenue is BAIC Motor's figure, and Beijing Offroad sits inside the Beijing brand [s3][s30].
overview.zh:
北京越野（Beijing Offroad）是北汽集团（北京汽车集团有限公司）旗下的越野车品牌，属于港交所上市公司北京汽车股份有限公司（01958.HK）整车板块中的北京品牌。公开文件没有把「北京汽车集团越野车有限公司」列为 01958.HK 的子公司，也没有列示它运营该品牌 [s3][s37]。品牌自居中国「越野世家」与国产越野车开创者，渊源可追溯至 1966 年 5 月定型投产的北京牌 BJ212 轻型越野车 [s1]。其业务为乘用越野车：硬派越野（BJ40、BJ60、BJ80）、轻越野（BJ30），以及 2026 年新推出的豪华越野子品牌泰钽（泰钽 700）与主流新能源 SUV 子品牌星钽（星钽 5X），动力覆盖燃油、增程（EREV）、插混与纯电，并越来越多地搭载华为乾崑智驾 [s24][s31][s33]。

经历多年沉寂后，品牌销量强劲回升：2025 年全年销量超 20 万辆、同比增长 38%（北汽集团口径），其中方盒子车型交付 147,499 辆、同比增长 72%，北汽集团称 BJ40 连续 11 个月居硬派越野销量第一、BJ40 增程连续 9 个月居增程式方盒子销量第一，北京汽车官网转载的《中国证券报》则写 BJ40 系列自 2025 年 7 月起稳居榜首。两说冲突，并列保留 [s2][s3]。2026 年上半年品牌销量 8.46 万辆，方盒子车型交付 6.67 万辆（同比 +33.9%）[s15]。

作为品牌，北京越野未单独上市、也不单独披露财务，业绩并入北京汽车股份的合并报表。北京品牌、北京奔驰、北京现代、福建奔驰是这家上市主体下面的四个整车板块，不是与北京汽车股份并列的四家主体。合并收入是北京汽车股份的合并数，北京越野在北京品牌里面 [s3][s30]。

current.en:
Business structure

Beijing Offroad is a pure passenger off-road-vehicle business: it runs no separate commercial-vehicle, battery or component segment, and its whole-vehicle results are consolidated in BAIC Motor (01958.HK). The Beijing brand, Beijing Benz, Beijing Hyundai and Fujian Benz are the four vehicle businesses under that listed company. Beijing Offroad is part of the Beijing brand, not a peer of the three joint ventures. The consolidated revenue figure is BAIC Motor's [s3][s30]. It is the core of BAIC Motor's own 'Beijing' brand, which also covers sedans and urban SUVs [s3].

Model line-up and brand matrix

As of the research cut-off (2026-10-29), Beijing Offroad's matrix is organised in three lines: the BJ series (BJ30, BJ40, BJ60, BJ80) defends the core, the Taitan series (Taitan 700) pushes upward, and the Xingtan series (Xingtan 5X) widens volume [s34][s24]. The BJ40 is the volume anchor. BAIC Group says it led hardcore off-road sales for 11 months in 2025; BAIC Motor's reprint of China Securities Journal says the BJ40 series has ranked first since July 2025. The two accounts conflict and both are kept, and the BJ30 is the entry point around the RMB100,000 class [s2][s9]. The Beijing Auto official site also lists a 'Yueji travel' series (X7, EU5, U5, EU7) of non-off-road cars, which belong to the Beijing brand rather than the off-road core [s24].

Latest performance (as of 2026-10-29)

For full-year 2025, Beijing Offroad sold more than 200,000 vehicles (+38%), with boxy 'box' models delivering 147,499 units (+72%); the hardcore off-road models built at the smart factory sold 76,000 units, roughly double 2024, and the BJ40 EREV sold 38,000 units in eight months, topping the EREV box segment; individual buyers made up 83% of box-model deliveries, up 13 percentage points; and the new 'Yuanjing Zhixing' model took over 5,000 orders within 24 hours of launch [s3][s4]. In Q1 2026, Beijing Offroad delivered 43,200 vehicles (+67%), including over 30,900 box models (+89%) and over 15,100 BJ40-series vehicles (+144%) [s32]. In H1 2026 the brand sold 84,600 vehicles, with 66,700 box models delivered (+33.9%), and added models such as the BJ40 EREV long-range edition and the BJ30 Traveller High-light edition [s15]. Parent BAIC Motor reported FY2025 consolidated revenue of RMB164.047 billion and net profit attributable to the parent of RMB123 million (down 87.2% year on year; prepared under IFRS) [s30]. For H1 2026 (six months ended 30 June 2026, unaudited, prepared under IAS 34) it reported revenue of RMB57.726 billion, down 29.9% year on year, and a net loss attributable to equity holders of the company of RMB1.594 billion, against a profit of RMB360 million a year earlier [s36]. For the first nine months of 2026 it reported revenue of RMB120.8 billion and attributable net profit of RMB51.29 million (down 98.3% year on year) under PRC GAAP, according to Hong Kong media [s35].

Technology and platforms

The electrification path centres on the 'Magic Core Electric Drive' (魔核电驱) solution released in 2024, applied to the BJ30 deep hybrid, BJ40 EREV and BJ60 EREV; the BJ40 EREV uses a 40.3kWh battery for 152 km of electric range and an 82L fuel tank for over 1,000 km of combined range [s9][s12]. On intelligence, the brand co-develops with Huawei: the Taitan 700 carries Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 MAX and the Xingtan 5X carries ADS 5 Pro, and in July 2026 Beijing Offroad and Huawei Yinwang inaugurated a 'joint off-road centre' [s31][s34]. On batteries it co-developed the 'Xiaoyao off-road edition' battery with CATL [s34].

Plant and capacity

The main production base is the Beijing Offroad Smart Factory in Zhaoquanying, Shunyi District, Beijing (about 540,000 sq m; media report annual capacity of roughly 100,000 vehicles), capable of flexible petrol, diesel and EREV production [s18][s19]. In September 2025 the factory's monthly output passed 10,000 units for the first time. The same ceremony's figure of 3.2 million vehicles is the combined output of four bases — the Shunyi smart factory plus BAIC Zhuzhou, Guangzhou and Kunming — not Beijing Offroad off-road vehicles alone [s19][s40].

Overseas business

Beijing Offroad's exports are handled centrally by BAIC International, and no separate brand-level export figure is disclosed. BAIC International covers more than 90 countries and regions under the BAIC, ARCFOX and STELATO brand matrix [s32]. Beijing Offroad plans to develop high-temperature, cold-climate and EU versions of its 2026 models for export to Europe, Central and South America and North Africa from late 2026 into early 2027 [s3].
current.zh:
业务结构

北京越野是纯乘用车越野业务，不经营商用车、动力电池等独立业务板块，整车经营业绩并入北京汽车股份有限公司（01958.HK）合并报表。北京品牌、北京奔驰、北京现代、福建奔驰是这家上市主体下面的四个整车板块。北京越野属于北京品牌，不是与三家合资并列的另一家主体。合并收入是北京汽车股份的合并数 [s3][s30]。它是北京汽车自主品牌「北京」品牌的核心组成，与轿车、城市 SUV 等产品共同构成北京汽车的自主乘用车序列 [s3]。

车型谱系与品牌矩阵

截至研究截止日（2026-10-29），北京越野的产品矩阵分三条线：BJ 系列（BJ30、BJ40、BJ60、BJ80）守基本盘，泰钽系列（泰钽 700）向上突破，星钽系列（星钽 5X）向宽走量 [s34][s24]。BJ40 是销量基盘。北汽集团称其 2025 年连续 11 个月居硬派越野销量第一；北京汽车官网转载的《中国证券报》写 BJ40 系列自 2025 年 7 月起稳居榜首。两说冲突，并列保留；BJ30 是 10 万元级的轻越野入口 [s2][s9]。此外，北京汽车官网还列示「悦己出行」系列（X7、EU5、U5、EU7）等非越野车型，属于北京品牌而非北京越野主业 [s24]。

近期业绩（截至 2026-10-29）

2025 年全年，北京越野销量超 20 万辆（+38%），方盒子车型交付 147,499 辆（+72%）；智能工厂生产的硬派越野车销量 7.6 万辆、较 2024 年近乎翻倍，BJ40 增程 8 个月售出 3.8 万辆、登顶增程式方盒子市场；方盒子车型个人用户占比达 83%、提升 13 个百分点；全新车型「元境智行」上市 24 小时订单破 5000 辆 [s3][s4]。2026 年一季度，北京越野终端交付 4.32 万辆、同比增长 67%，其中方盒子家族交付超 3.09 万辆（+89%）、BJ40 系列交付突破 1.51 万辆（+144%）[s32]。2026 年上半年品牌销量 8.46 万辆，方盒子车型交付 6.67 万辆（+33.9%），BJ40 增程长续航版、BJ30 旅行家高光版等新品陆续上市 [s15]。母公司北京汽车 2025 财年合并营业收入 1640.47 亿元、归属于母公司股东净利润 1.23 亿元（同比降 87.2%）[s30]；2026 年中期（截至 2026-06-30，按《国际会计准则》第 34 号编制、未经审计）营业收入 577.26 亿元、同比降 29.9%，本公司权益持有人应占净亏损 15.94 亿元、由盈转亏（上年同期盈利 3.60 亿元）[s36]；其 2026 年前三季按中国会计准则实现营业收入 1,208 亿元、归属股东净利润 5,129 万元（同比降 98.3%，据港媒报道）[s35]。

技术与平台

电动化路径以 2024 年发布的「魔核电驱超级驱动方案」为核心，落地「三剑客」——BJ30 深混、BJ40 增程、BJ60 增程；其中 BJ40 增程采用 40.3kWh 电池、纯电续航 152 公里，配 82L 油箱综合续航超 1000 公里 [s9][s12]。智能化上，品牌与华为深度共创：泰钽 700 搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 MAX、星钽 5X 搭载 ADS 5 Pro，并于 2026 年 7 月与华为引望挂牌成立「联合越野中心」[s31][s34]。电池层面联合宁德时代开发「骁遥电池越野专研版」[s34]。

工厂与产能

主要生产基地为北京越野智能工厂（北京顺义区赵全营镇，占地约 54 万平方米，媒体披露年产能力约 10 万辆），可实现汽油、柴油、增程等多车型柔性生产 [s18][s19]。2025 年 9 月该工厂单月产量首次突破 1 万辆。同一仪式报道的累计生产 320 万辆，是以顺义智能工厂为核心，加上北汽株洲、广州、昆明基地的四大基地合计产量，不是北京越野越野车的单一产量 [s19][s40]。

海外业务

北京越野的出口由北汽国际统筹，未单独披露品牌级海外销量。北汽国际已覆盖 90 多个国家和地区，形成 BAIC、ARCFOX、STELATO 三大海外品牌矩阵 [s32]。北京越野计划为 2026 年新车同步开发高温版、高寒版、欧盟版等国际版型，拟于 2026 年底至 2027 年初出口欧洲、中南美、北非等地区 [s3]。

leadership.en:
Founder

Beijing Offroad has no single entrepreneur-founder: it is a state-created brand whose lineage runs from the Beijing Automobile Works' BJ212, developed from 1960 and approved for production in 1966 [s1]. The BJ212 and its derivatives long served as parade command and gun-salute-towing vehicles at Tiananmen Square [s1].

Current management

  • Zhang Guofu (张国富) — deputy general manager of BAIC Group and chairman of Beijing Offroad; he has chaired BAIC Motor (01958.HK) since 14 April 2026. On 20 March 2026 the board only proposed appointing him as a non-executive director and, if shareholders approved, nominating him as chairman; Wang Hao's resignation took effect when that appointment was approved. The EGM on 14 April 2026 approved it, and the board appointed him chairman the same day. His resignation as BAIC Bluepark chairman took effect on 19 March 2026 (announced 20 March), which is not the effective date of the BAIC Motor chairmanship. Born July 1977, he holds a project-management engineering master's degree from Beijing Institute of Technology and is a senior engineer. From 2019 he served successively as deputy party secretary and executive deputy general manager, then general manager, of Beijing Automotive Group Off-road Vehicle Co., Ltd., and as deputy party secretary and executive vice president of BAIC Motor; he became general manager of BAIC Bluepark (and party secretary and general manager of Beijing New Energy Vehicle) in July 2024, BAIC Bluepark chairman in March 2025. He stepped down as BAIC Bluepark chairman with effect from 19 March 2026, and became chairman of BAIC Motor on 14 April 2026 [s26][s37][s38][s39][s31].
  • Chen Geng (陈更) — president of BAIC Motor (北汽股份总裁) since 29 November 2025, when Song Wei ceased to be president. In a January 2026 interview he described the company's marketing, quality and cost work across 2025; that full-year programme is not his record as president for the whole year [s3][s41].
  • Xu Feng (徐峰) — general manager of the Beijing Offroad product centre, who set out the 2026 launch plan and the 'off-road democratisation' roadmap [s3][s5].
  • Wang Chunfeng (王春风) — general manager of the Beijing Offroad sales company, who described the channel expansion and user operations [s3].
  • Zhu Baiqing (朱百庆) — general manager of the Beijing Offroad Smart Factory, who described the flexible and digital manufacturing [s3].

Predecessor and governance

Former BAIC Motor chairman Wang Hao (born December 1982, PhD in economics) served as chairman from 13 March 2025 until 14 April 2026, when Zhang Guofu succeeded him [s30][s38]. Beijing Offroad is not an independently listed legal entity; its parent BAIC Motor is controlled by BAIC Group, a Beijing municipal wholly state-owned enterprise ultimately controlled by the Beijing Municipal SASAC (see the BAIC Group deep research for the ownership chain) [s2].
leadership.zh:
创始人

北京越野没有民营意义上的单一创始人：它是国家创建的品牌，血脉源自北京汽车制造厂自 1960 年研发、1966 年定型投产的 BJ212 [s1]。BJ212 及其衍生车型此后长期担任阅兵指挥车、礼炮牵引车等装备平台，多次驶过天安门广场 [s1]。

现任核心管理层

  • 张国富——北汽集团副总经理、北京越野董事长，自 2026 年 4 月 14 日起担任北京汽车（01958.HK）董事长。2026 年 3 月 20 日董事会只是建议委任他为非执行董事，待股东批准后再提名董事长；王昊卸任自该委任获批准之日起生效。2026 年 4 月 14 日临时股东会通过后，董事会同日委任他为董事长。他卸任北汽蓝谷董事长于 2026 年 3 月 19 日生效（3 月 20 日公告），与北京汽车董事长的生效日不是同一天，也不能写成同一个月。1977 年 7 月出生，北京理工大学项目管理专业工程硕士、高级工程师。2019 年起先后任北京汽车集团越野车有限公司党委副书记、常务副总经理，后任总经理，并曾任北京汽车党委副书记、常务副总裁；2024 年 7 月任北汽蓝谷总经理（北京新能源汽车股份有限公司党委书记、总经理）；2025 年 3 月任北汽蓝谷董事长；卸任北汽蓝谷董事长于 2026 年 3 月 19 日生效，出任北京汽车董事长则自 2026 年 4 月 14 日起 [s26][s37][s38][s39][s31]。
  • 陈更——北京汽车（北汽股份）总裁，自 2025 年 11 月 29 日起任职，宋玮同日不再担任总裁。2026 年 1 月的采访里，他介绍公司把「营销、质量、成本」贯穿 2025 年经营；这是对全年工作的表述，不能理解成他以总裁身份主导了全年 [s3][s41]。
  • 徐峰——北京越野产品中心总经理，对外介绍 2026 年新车投放与「越野平权」规划 [s3][s5]。
  • 王春风——北京越野销售公司总经理，介绍渠道拓展与用户运营 [s3]。
  • 朱百庆——北京越野智能工厂总经理，介绍柔性生产与数字化制造 [s3]。

前任与治理

前任北京汽车董事长王昊为「80 后」高管（1982 年 12 月生，经济学博士），自 2025 年 3 月 13 日起担任董事长，至 2026 年 4 月 14 日由张国富接任 [s30][s38]。北京越野并非独立上市法人；其母公司北京汽车由北汽集团控股，北汽集团是北京市属国有独资企业，最终实际控制人为北京市国资委（股权链条详见北汽集团 baic 深度研究）[s2]。

competition.en:
Our judgment: the competitive field. Beijing Offroad competes in China's fast-growing hardcore and 'boxy' (方盒子) off-road segment. Its direct rivals include Great Wall Motor's Tank brand, BYD's Fangchengbao (Bao 5), Chery's Jetour Traveller and the Haval Big Dog [s28]. Tank in particular had led the Chinese hardcore off-road SUV segment for 39 consecutive months as of early 2024 [s28]. The market is expanding: domestic boxy-SUV sales reached about 1.02 million units in 2025, and media cite an institutional forecast of up to 1.5 million units in 2026 [s34][s13]. This is an analytical selection of competitors, not a sales ranking.

Our judgment: strengths. The brand's clearest asset is its heritage: as the maker of the BJ212 it can credibly claim to be China's original off-road brand, and the BJ212 series has sold over 1.2 million units. The September 2025 ceremony figure of 3.2 million vehicles is, in the same report, the combined output of four bases — the Shunyi smart factory plus BAIC Zhuzhou, Guangzhou and Kunming — not Beijing Offroad off-road production alone [s1][s40]. Its 2025 results show it has converted that into a volume recovery — over 200,000 units, with BAIC Group saying the BJ40 led hardcore off-road for 11 months and the BJ40 EREV topped the EREV box segment, while BAIC Motor's reprint of China Securities Journal says the BJ40 series has ranked first since July 2025. Those two accounts conflict and both are kept. The volume recovery is supported by a growing individual-buyer base (83% of box-model deliveries) [s2][s3][s6]. The Huawei assisted-driving partnership and the CATL battery co-development give it a route into the intelligent off-road tier, backed by its accumulated off-road driving data [s34].

Our judgment: weaknesses. The same heritage did not stop rivals overtaking it: in 2023 its four main models sold only about 34,000 units, far behind Tank, and media noted it once missed the first-mover bonus of the hardcore off-road boom [s28]. Its recovery leans heavily on the sub-RMB200,000 BJ40/BJ30 volume tier, while the above-RMB300,000 Taitan 700 is an unproven new model whose pre-sale orders (over 10,000) have yet to be matched by sustained deliveries [s13].
competition.zh:
我们的判断：竞争范围。北京越野处于中国快速扩容的硬派越野与「方盒子」细分赛道，直接对手包括长城坦克、比亚迪方程豹（豹 5）、奇瑞捷途旅行者、哈弗大狗等 [s28]。其中坦克品牌截至 2024 年初已连续 39 个月蝉联中国硬派越野 SUV 销量冠军 [s28]。市场正在扩容：国内方盒子 SUV 2025 年销量约 102 万辆，媒体引机构预测 2026 年有望冲击 150 万辆 [s34][s13]。此为分析所选竞争范围，并非销量排名。

我们的判断：优势。品牌最核心的资产是历史：作为 BJ212 的制造者，它有底气自称中国越野车开创者，BJ212 系列累计超过 120 万辆。2025 年 9 月仪式上的「累计生产突破 320 万辆」，据同一报道，是以顺义智能工厂为核心，加上北汽株洲、广州、昆明基地的四大基地合计产量，不是北京越野越野车的单一产量 [s1][s40]。2025 年的数据表明其已把历史转化为销量复苏——超 20 万辆。北汽集团称 BJ40 连续 11 个月硬派越野第一、BJ40 增程登顶增程方盒子；北京汽车官网转载的《中国证券报》写 BJ40 系列自 2025 年 7 月起稳居榜首。两说冲突，并列保留。个人用户占比达 83% [s2][s3][s6]。与华为的智驾合作、与宁德时代的电池合作，加上其积累的越野实测数据，为其打开智能越野层级提供了路径 [s34]。

我们的判断：短板。同样的历史并未阻止其长期被对手反超：2023 年其四款主力越野车合计仅售约 3.4 万辆、与坦克品牌差距悬殊，媒体也指出其一度错过硬派越野爆发期的先发红利 [s28]。其复苏高度依赖 20 万元以下的 BJ40/BJ30 走量区间，而 30 万元级以上的泰钽 700 是未经验证的新车型，预售热度（订单超 1 万辆）尚未被持续交付证实 [s13]。

outlook.en:
Company plans. For 2026, BAIC Motor president Chen Geng disclosed a target of over 200,000 domestic sales plus 100,000 overseas, for a total of more than 300,000 units [s5]. The brand plans several new models through 2026: the BJ40 Explorer in Q1, the BJ40 EREV 2026 update and a new BJ60 with Huawei assisted driving in Q2, the BJ30 update and the user-co-created C-class BJ81 in Q3, and an A+-class light off-road model (petrol, BEV and PHEV) in Q4 [s5][s3]. Product-centre general manager Xu Feng said the brand would cover the A0-to-D segments across light, professional and luxury off-road series over three years, targeting one million units by 2030 [s3]. On technology it is pushing 'off-road democratisation' (越野平权) across fuel, EREV, PHEV and BEV; the Taitan 700 is positioned as an 'all-scenario luxury intelligent off-road SUV', which BAIC Group chairman Zhang Jianyong said is meant to 'redefine luxury off-road' [s13]. These are disclosed plans and targets, not achieved results.

Our judgment. The 300,000-unit 2026 target implies roughly 216,000 units in H2 after 84,600 in H1 [s15], a significant step-up that depends on the new-model cadence and on the Taitan/Xingtan launches converting orders into sustained volume [s5][s33]. The brand's recovery rests on two premises: that the BJ40/BJ30 base keeps growing without a repeat of the 2023-2024 slowdown, and that the Taitan move above RMB300,000 holds up against the Tank 500/700 and Fangchengbao. An alternative is that the crowded 'boxy' segment — media report nearly 20 new off-road launches in the first seven months of 2026 — intensifies price competition and stalls the up-market push [s13]. This is our analysis and does not constitute a forecast of financial results.
outlook.zh:
公司公开规划。北京汽车总裁陈更披露 2026 年目标：内销 20 万辆以上、外销 10 万辆，冲击 30 万辆以上总销量 [s5]。品牌计划 2026 年投放多款新车：一季度 BJ40 探险家，二季度 BJ40 增程 2026 款及搭载华为智驾的全新 BJ60，三季度 BJ30 改款及用户共创的 C 级 SUV 北京 81，四季度一款 A+ 级轻越野车型（燃油、纯电、插混多种动力）[s5][s3]。产品中心总经理徐峰披露，未来三年将以轻越野、专业越野、豪华越野三大系列布局 A0 到 D 级市场，2030 年冲击百万销量规模 [s3]。技术层面在燃油、增程、插混、纯电多动力上推进「越野平权」；泰钽 700 被定位为「全场景豪华智能越野 SUV」，北汽集团董事长张建勇称其意在「重新定义豪华越野」[s13]。以上为披露的计划与目标，并非已实现的业绩。

我们的判断。2026 年 30 万辆目标意味着在上半年 8.46 万辆之后，下半年需交付约 21.6 万辆，显著提速 [s15]，取决于新车节奏以及泰钽/星钽能否把预售订单转化为持续销量 [s5][s33]。品牌复苏依赖两个前提：BJ40/BJ30 基盘持续增长、不再重演 2023—2024 年的放缓；以及泰钽在 30 万元以上与坦克 500/700、方程豹的竞争中站住脚。另一种可能是，「方盒子」赛道拥挤——媒体称 2026 年前 7 个月主流越野新车投放近 20 款——价格竞争加剧，使向上突破受阻 [s13]。以上为我们的分析，不构成对财务结果的预测。

risks.en:
• Concentrated volume base. Growth depends heavily on the sub-RMB200,000 BJ40 and BJ30; a slowdown in this tier would directly hit overall volume, as happened in 2023 when the four main models sold only about 34,000 units [s28].
  • Unproven premium push. The Taitan 700 is a first attempt above RMB300,000; its pre-sale orders (over 10,000) have yet to be matched by sustained deliveries [s13].
  • Intense competition. The boxy off-road segment is crowded, with media reporting nearly 20 new off-road launches in the first seven months of 2026 and established rivals such as Tank and Fangchengbao [s13][s28].
  • No separate financial disclosure. Beijing Offroad publishes no brand-level revenue or profit, so standalone profitability cannot be assessed from public filings; its results are consolidated in BAIC Motor, whose FY2025 attributable net profit was RMB123 million, down 87.2% year on year, and whose H1 2026 attributable net loss was RMB1,594 million, swinging from a profit [s36] [s30].
  • Leadership churn. The BAIC Motor chairmanship changed twice in about a year: Wang Hao from 13 March 2025, then Zhang Guofu with effect from 14 April 2026. The 20 March 2026 board meeting only proposed that appointment, adding execution uncertainty around the handover [s37][s38].
  • Technology dependence on partners. The intelligent off-road positioning leans on Huawei's assisted-driving stack and CATL batteries, tying part of the brand's differentiation to third parties [s14][s34].
risks.zh:
• 销量基盘集中。增长高度依赖 20 万元以下的 BJ40、BJ30；该区间一旦放缓将直接冲击总量，2023 年四款主力车型合计仅约 3.4 万辆即为例证 [s28]。
  • 向上突破未经验证。泰钽 700 是品牌首次冲击 30 万元以上市场，预售订单（超 1 万辆）尚未被持续交付证实 [s13]。
  • 竞争激烈。方盒子赛道拥挤，媒体称 2026 年前 7 个月主流越野新车投放近 20 款，且面临坦克、方程豹等既有对手 [s13][s28]。
  • 无单独财务披露。北京越野未披露品牌层面营收与利润，独立盈利能力无法从公开文件评估；业绩并入北京汽车，后者 2025 财年归母净利润 1.23 亿元、同比降 87.2%，2026 年中期权益持有人应占净亏损 15.94 亿元、由盈转亏 [s36] [s30]。
  • 管理层更替。北京汽车董事长大约一年内两次变动：王昊自 2025 年 3 月 13 日起任职，张国富自 2026 年 4 月 14 日起接任。2026 年 3 月 20 日董事会只是提议委任，交接窗口带来执行层面的不确定性 [s37][s38]。
  • 对合作伙伴的技术依赖。智能越野定位倚重华为智驾体系与宁德时代电池，品牌差异化部分系于第三方 [s14][s34]。
